stats.sort.label: Sort by
stats.sort.frequency.note: Sorting by frequency does not make numbers "hot": the differences are within chance.
stats.dist.title: Distributions
stats.dist.explain: The theoretical distribution is calculated exactly. A gap to the observed one within chance is normal.
stats.why.title: Why this is not a forecast
stats.why.independence.a: The balls have no memory of past draws. The chance of each number in the next draw does not depend on how often it came up before.
stats.why.gambler.a: The thought "this number has not come up for a while, so it is due" is wrong. So is the opposite: "this number comes up often, so it is on a streak". That is why there are no "hot" or "cold" numbers here.
stats.why.p.a: A high p says the deviations are typical for random draws. A low p only says the deviation is unusual. It may point to an error in the data rather than to a pattern.

about.title: About the method and data
about.intro: How the app calculates, where its data comes from and what it cannot do.
about.principles.title: What the app does and does not do
about.principles.p1: The app does not predict numbers. Draws of Lotto 6 aus 49 and EuroJackpot are random and independent: past results say nothing about the next one.
about.principles.p2: The chance of winning is the same for every combination. The "rarely chosen" mode does not raise it. It only lowers the likelihood of sharing a prize with other players if a win does happen.
about.principles.p3: The app takes no bets, sells no participation and shows no ads. It is a personal tool: it calculates, checks tickets and explains how the figures are obtained.
about.principles.p4: We do not use "hot" and "cold" numbers, "smart" picks or a "confidence" score: for a fair lottery they have no mathematical meaning.
about.generator.title: Generator and popularity estimate
about.generator.rng: Numbers are created in your browser with crypto.getRandomValues, a cryptographic random number generator. The choice is uniform: every number has the same chance.
about.generator.rejection: The "rarely chosen" mode works like this: the generator creates a random combination and discards it if any popularity rule (strong or weak) fires. This repeats until a combination passes. The chance of winning does not change.
about.generator.rules: The popularity estimate is a heuristic with open rules: dates (numbers up to 31), sequences, consecutive numbers, patterns on the Lotto 6 aus 49 slip, multiples and a shared last digit, and matches with past winning numbers. We show which rules applied and do not turn them into percentages: there are no reliable numerical weights.
about.generator.sources: Basis: Henze (1997), "A statistical and probabilistic analysis of popular lottery tickets", Statistica Neerlandica 51(2); Henze and Riedwyl (1998), "How to Win More", A K Peters; Simon (1998), Journal of Risk and Uncertainty 17(3).
about.generator.caveat: Caveat: some rules (for example "Dates") rest on summaries in popular guides, not on a primary source, hence the wording "probably popular". The studies concern 6 aus 49 slips and the UK lottery; there is no direct data for EuroJackpot.
about.generator.euro: Euro numbers are generated at random and not rated for popularity. The Superzahl is not generated: it is the last digit of the slip number.
about.odds.title: Probabilities and expected value
about.odds.ej: EuroJackpot: 5 from 50 and 2 from 12. In total C(50,5) · C(12,2) = 2,118,760 · 66 = 139,838,160 combinations. For class "k + m" the number of combinations is C(5,k) · C(45,5−k) · C(2,m) · C(10,2−m).
about.odds.649: Lotto 6 aus 49: 6 from 49 and a Superzahl 0–9. In total C(49,6) · 10 = 139,838,160 combinations. For "k + SZ" the number is C(6,k) · C(43,6−k), for "k" without SZ the same multiplied by 9.
about.odds.check: The calculated values match the official odds tables on lotto.de. The probability of "any win" is the sum of all classes; this is our own calculation.
about.odds.ev: The expected value of a field is roughly the payout share multiplied by the field price. In Lotto 6 aus 49, 50% of stakes goes to prizes (lotto.de). For EuroJackpot the share is calculated from the official prize amounts and stakes of all draws in the archive; you can change it on the "Odds" screen.
about.odds.evCaveat: The exact value depends on the draw, the jackpot, the number of winners and the fixed prize of class 9. This is an estimate.
about.stats.title: Statistics and the randomness check
about.stats.expected: Expected frequency of a number: E = D · k / N, where D is the number of draws, k is how many numbers are drawn, and N is the size of the number pool.
about.stats.statistic: Measure of deviation: X² = Σ (O − E)² / E, where O is the observed frequency. Numbers in one draw are taken without replacement, so the usual χ² distribution fits only approximately.
about.stats.montecarlo: So p is calculated by Monte Carlo: the app simulates thousands of random histories of the same length with the same generator and looks at the share in which X² is at least as large as the observed value. This is honest and needs no corrections.
about.stats.eras: EuroJackpot changed the Euro-number format: from 23.03.2012 2 of 8, from 10.10.2014 2 of 10, from 25.03.2022 2 of 12. Euro numbers are therefore counted within one era only. Otherwise the newer numbers would look "cold" just because of their short history.
about.stats.notForecast: The test result describes the past. It does not make any number a better choice for the next draw.
about.data.title: Data and sources
about.data.649: Lotto 6 aus 49: the open archive `daowa89/lottery-archive` on GitHub (CSV since 1955, Superzahl since December 1991). The archive's scripts are MIT-licensed, but the data belongs to third parties (lottozahlenonline.de) and is for personal, non-commercial use. A random sample of draws was cross-checked with the official WestLotto service.
about.data.ej: EuroJackpot: the official website eurojackpot.com (its JSON service with numbers and prize amounts), a one-time import of all draws since 23.03.2012. No explicit reuse licence was found and the operator publishes the data "without guarantee", so it is for personal use only and is not republished.
about.data.manual: New draws are added manually on the "Data and settings" screen (CSV or entering the numbers): EuroJackpot on Tuesdays and Fridays, Lotto 6 aus 49 on Wednesdays and Saturdays. They are stored in this browser. The built-in archive is updated with the scripts in the `scripts` folder. There is no automatic update.

about.data.privacy.title: What happens to your data
about.data.privacy.p1: The app collects no personal data and needs no account. Your tickets are stored only in this browser (localStorage) and are not sent anywhere. The JSON export file is created on your device.
about.data.privacy.p2: The draw archive is loaded as a static file from the same address as the app. The app has no data server: tickets, added draws and settings are stored only in this browser. Like any website, the host sees technical request data such as the IP address.
about.data.privacy.p3: Fonts are bundled locally, and there is no analytics or third-party script. The page is closed to search engine indexing.
about.limits.title: Known limitations
about.limits.i1: The EuroJackpot payout share is calculated from the official prize amounts and stakes of past draws. It is an average over the whole archive: in a single draw the share depends on the jackpot and the number of winners.
about.limits.i2: Prize amounts (quotas) are available for EuroJackpot only: they come from the official data together with the numbers. For Lotto 6 aus 49 the archive only has dates and numbers, so see the official quotas. Exception: the fixed 6 € in class 9.
about.limits.i3: The EuroJackpot slip layout has not been verified, so the "Pattern on the slip" rule is switched off for this game.
about.limits.i4: The popularity estimate is a heuristic, not a measurement. Players' actual preferences may differ.
about.limits.i5: Ticket checking depends on how complete the loaded draws are. If a draw is not loaded, the ticket stays unchecked.
about.limits.i6: The app gives no financial advice. It calculates and explains.
